constraints.statement: Clean-room rule: sidemantic code is never opened or ported; only its public docs and the Cube/dbt/Ossie formats (from their original specs) inform the typed model schema.
constraints.implication: The new model schema + YAML/Ossie loader are authored from public format docs; the branch's sidemantic-API glue (loader.py, sidemantic_engine.py, Ossie compat shim) is deleted, not adapted.

constraints.statement: Owner decision (2026-10-25): the FEAT-704 branch is a salvage source, not a merge base.
constraints.implication: Rev2 starts a fresh worktree from origin/dev and checks out only zero-reference files from the branch; the 20 `done` stamps on the branch are not carried over.

constraints.statement: Ibis is a recorded NO-GO (TASK-1437) codified as a FEAT-704 Non-Goal; the NO-GO concerned connections, not compile-only use.
constraints.implication: 'BSL reserved for the joins phase' needs an explicit re-scoping of the NO-GO in the spec that opens that phase; rev2 itself adds no Ibis/BSL dependency.

constraints.statement: Determinism is a contract: byte-identical SQL per (model digest, canonical query, dialect); no dict/set iteration into SELECT/GROUP BY/IN order (SemaFlow HashMap lesson).
constraints.implication: Satellite pins sqlglot narrowly (branch: `>=30.1,<31`, venv 30.23.0; core floor `>=20.0` is too loose) and ships per-dialect golden SQL tests.

constraints.statement: Governance (PBAC gate, lineage, RLS push-down, masking, positive guard, signed audit) operates on the compiled sqlglot AST and is already engine-neutral on the branch.
constraints.implication: Nothing in governance/, audit, cache, catalog, execution, results, toolkit or the HTTP handler changes semantically; only the `engine` field disappears from CompiledQuery/ModelPolicy.

constraints.statement: FEAT-713 (draft) creates the sidemantic-free satellite skeleton and asks FEAT-704 to 'extend' it (Q10); both target 1.3.0 and neither has landed.
constraints.implication: Rev2 must fix skeleton ownership and ordering; `parrot.semantic.accounting` must stay importable without the generic layer.

constraints.statement: FEAT-738 (merged 2026-10-24) shipped the request-scoped RLS fix that FEAT-704 M12/TASK-4482 also implements; the branch conflicts with dev exactly on those files.
constraints.implication: Drop M12/TASK-4482 from rev2; never salvage the branch's authorizing.py / handlers/datasets.py / uv.lock.

constraints.statement: Rust/PyO3 precedents exist (navrules pyo3 0.29 abi3-py311 + maturin, parrot_codec, yaml_rs), with worktree native_group copying and a maturin-action release matrix; THIRD_PARTY.md does not exist.
constraints.implication: The Rust phase follows the navrules layout, registers a native_group and a release job, and creates THIRD_PARTY.md with the SemaFlow MIT header before the first derived line lands.

constraints.statement: The native compiler already implements declared one-to-many joins with fan-out rejection, while the decision block says 'no joins in v1'.
constraints.implication: Rev2 must choose between keeping the branch's join subset or stripping to single-table (owner decision U4); either way symmetric/cumulative metrics stay out of v1.

constraints.statement: Two open ledger issues (issue:3c4d154c0172, issue:46e8f6219bf5) were raised against the branch's toolkit/catalog code.
constraints.implication: They are claimed and fixed in the tasks that salvage toolkit.py / catalog.py, not left open.

constraints.statement: Compile stays CPU-only under asyncio.to_thread; no semantic-layer library is async.
constraints.implication: Unchanged pipeline shape: SemanticQuery → RLS rewrite → to_thread(compile) → positive guard → cache → async execution.

new: `parrot/semantic/model.py` — typed, frozen Pydantic v2 semantic model graph (SemanticModel, Dimension incl. time grain, Metric with `agg`/`sql`/optional `filter`, derived Metric expression, Relationship with cardinality) with sorted, canonical digests; authored from Cube / dbt MetricFlow / Ossie public specs (clean-room).

`parrot/semantic/loader.py` (rewrite) — reads the own YAML format and Ossie 0.1.1 documents into the typed graph; keeps PhysicalSchema, policy binding, digests and fingerprint logic from the branch; no temp staging, no sidemantic importer shim.

`engines/native.py` → sole compiler (`compiler.py` or kept path): re-pointed to the typed graph; v1 additions decided in spec — filtered measures lowered to `FILTER (WHERE …)` or `CASE WHEN` per dialect (SemaFlow design reference, attributed), derived metrics over metrics; fan-out rejection kept.
Golden SQL fixtures per dialect (postgres, bigquery, duckdb) + DuckDB execution oracle replacing the sidemantic parity tests; cross-process determinism test (hash-seed) per brainstorm S2.

Rust phase (separate FEAT, after the Python compiler stabilises): PyO3 crate deriving SemaFlow `sql_ast.rs` + `dialect/` under MIT with attribution; `THIRD_PARTY.md`; native_group + release matrix entries.
Spec amendment artefacts: FEAT-704 spec rev 0.3 (engine section, pins, ACs, §8 Q1/Q2 superseded), re-scoped TASK-4467/4468, dropped TASK-4482.

modified.change: G5 → 'no AGPL dependency; satellite is MIT-only'; G7 → 'single native compiler'; Non-Goals: keep Ibis NO-GO wording but add 'BSL/Ibis may be re-evaluated compile-only for a later joins phase'; §2 Overview rewritten around the typed graph; M1 pins drop sidemantic/jsonschema-or-keep-jsonschema for Ossie; M4 becomes 'typed model + loader'; M5 'sole compiler'; AC1/AC11/AC16/AC18 lose sidemantic; §8 Q1/Q2 marked superseded.
TASK-4467 re-scoped to typed model + loader (no spike); TASK-4468 to sole engine + golden tests; TASK-4482 dropped (FEAT-738); statuses stay pending on dev.
dependencies = ai-parrot, sqlglot (narrow pin), pyyaml, jsonschema (Ossie); no sidemantic; extras duckdb/bigquery; README licence notice removed; Layering section per FEAT-713.
keep the TID251 `sidemantic` ban repo-wide as a permanent guard; remove the per-file ignore for the satellite; test_packaging asserts the ban fires everywhere.
remove the `engine` Literal (or fix to a single value) and its default.
re-express in the own YAML format; orders.policy.yaml drops `engine:`.
re-apply the branch's worker-thread execution fix on top of dev.
resolve Q10: rev2 names the skeleton owner and the 'extend' rule.

untouched: governance/{guard,lineage,masking,pbac,pipeline,rls}.py, audit.py, cache.py, catalog.py, context.py, errors.py, execution.py, results.py, toolkit.py, ossie.py (validation), handlers/semantic.py — salvaged as-is modulo import re-verification
SemanticQuery contract, sl_* tool surface, mcp-local YAML section, HTTP routes, result handles, signed audit ledger
Ibis / BSL — no dependency added in rev2; joins phase is a later spec
Symmetric aggregates, cumulative / time-comparison / cohort metrics (were sidemantic-only; remain out of v1)

risks.risk: Salvage drift: the branch is 1,379 commits behind dev and conflicts on core files.
risks.impact_mitigation: Only zero-reference satellite files + handler are checked out from the branch into a fresh worktree off origin/dev; core files are re-applied by hand; CI import boundary tests re-run.

risks.risk: Loss of the sidemantic parity oracle for AC11/AC18.
risks.impact_mitigation: Replace with golden SQL per dialect + DuckDB execution against hand-computed expectations + cross-process determinism check.

risks.risk: Skeleton ownership race between FEAT-713 and FEAT-704 rev2 (same pyproject, same 1.3.0).
risks.impact_mitigation: Spec names one owner; the other task 'extends' with a byte-level diff check (FEAT-713 already mandates this for version.py).

risks.risk: 'BSL reserved for joins' silently contradicts the recorded Ibis NO-GO.
risks.impact_mitigation: Rev2 spec states the NO-GO scope (connections) and that any joins-phase spec must re-open it explicitly; no Ibis dependency now.

risks.risk: Scope regression if 'no joins in v1' strips the branch's working one-to-many subset.
risks.impact_mitigation: Owner decision U4 in the spec; default recommendation is to keep the already-tested one-to-many subset with fan-out rejection.

risks.risk: Rust phase dependency hygiene: SemaFlow LICENSE is an unfilled template and BigQuery pulls a personal git fork / `ring`.
risks.impact_mitigation: Derive only sql_ast.rs + dialect/ (serde_json-only); record upstream copyright as best known in THIRD_PARTY.md; open the upstream wheel issue.
